  "memo":"R08 holds because three accounts share the shipping address. The household exception does not apply: although this is the home address, it was only recently registered. Linkage is the sole adverse family; all other rule conditions are unmet, including R04 because the amount is below the category's upper reference. No earlier outcome settles the order, and no check has run. Legitimate household sharing is more plausible than fabricated identities but remains unverified. Recommend needs_check with issuer authentication and identity verification; contact would not satisfy the Linkage requirement. With only Linkage present, decline and escalate are prohibited on current evidence. No installments were due, so repayment intent cannot support action. The order remains unshipped."
